openFindings.title: AC-005 claims the shipped runs match five earlier runs while the recorded evidence covers two
advisor_status reports the semantic lane enabled while the lane's own gate refuses to score
incompleteIds is exported but has no production consumer and mixes two id spaces
No test exercises a stale or missing command vector, so the new command coverage fields are only asserted at zero
OLLAMA_BASE_URL is forwarded and used without a loopback check, so the shared daemon ships the whole corpus to whatever host the first caller names
One changelog section cites two different corpus sizes for one measurement
The background refresh single-flight drops a reindex that lands mid-refresh
The background-refresh disable switch fails open on any value other than off
The changelog records two different ablation score pairs for the same lane, and the first appears nowhere in the packet ablation table
The changelog says the launcher always sets SYSTEM_SKILL_ADVISOR_DB_DIR, but the code only fills it when the operator has not set it
The changelog states the archived 149/193 ablation as the reason for the shipped default weight
The coverage check re-reads every SKILL.md on each scored prompt
The coverage gate re-scans every vector blob and the command-bridges file on each scoring call
The coverage reader re-implements the vector-table read the embedding loader already owns
The docs define three of the eight disabledReason tokens the code can emit
The exact-subset rerank has no coverage gate
The fixture-dimension guard is one-directional
The hand-over test hand-copies the writer path from a constant the module keeps private
The hub-vocabulary fix removed the phrase from the two checked surfaces and left two copies in the mode's own router reference
The incomplete_skill_vectors reason also fires for a missing command vector
The lane logs the adapter raw error message, which embeds the configured base URL verbatim
The lane weight guard reads a constant named DEFAULT_SCORER_LANE_WEIGHTS that actually holds the resolved live weights
The Ollama-unavailable early return reports zero failures
The packet summary claims 581 recorded answers while the decision and the commits say 231 and 227
The refresh page promises a watcher refresh after every reindex, but the single-flight guard drops one that lands mid-refresh
The semantic coverage gate opens the daemon-owned skill-graph database read-write on the recommend path
The semantic coverage gate opens the read-write database on the recommend path
The semantic lane coverage gate opens the read-write database handle from the recommend path
The status page describes laneEnabled as whether the semantic lane is enabled, but the field omits the coverage gate that disables scoring
The stress diagnostics test restates the semantic lane's live weight instead of deriving it, and the value it replaced was the lane's shadow weight
The widened hook assertion accepts variable names the hook does not use
Two claims already recorded as wrong are stated again in the older changelog, so fixing one file leaves the other

nodes.question: Vector refresh lifecycle: is the background refresh single-flight, can it overlap a watcher reindex or a second refresh, does an Ollama outage mid-refresh keep the old vectors, and can a refresh block, crash or leak in the daemon?

Status and doctor surfaces: are the current, stale and missing counts in advisor_status right for skills and commands, is includeSemanticHealth wired end to end, do the doctor setup, embedder, update, overlay and symlink assets draw PASS, DEGRADED and FAIL correctly including exit 75, and do the create-command workflows gate on the bridge check?

Semantic lane honesty: with a missing or stale vector does the lane return no match and report incomplete_skill_vectors, does a failed prompt embed leave the live total, is the fixture-dimension guard sound for a real 768-dim prompt, and does weight 0 skip every embed and coverage read?

Claims against code: does every statement in the changelogs, feature catalog, playbooks, references and install docs match shipped behavior, including the ablation result of 156 against 161 correct that set the lane weight to 0?

Daemon and launcher liveness: can the 5-minute heartbeat reaper stop a healthy server, does the child always get the launcher's database directory, are OLLAMA_BASE_URL and OLLAMA_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS passed safely, and can the generation counter land beside the wrong database?

Follow-up fixes and answer routing: did any of the five test or routing fixes weaken coverage or hide a real bug, did removing the bare security policy phrase break a route that should still reach sk-doc, and did each of the 231 ended-session answers land once in the right packet's decision record with no personal data?
